answer: A newcomer earns standing by staffing one seasonal field post. Each week they file a dated plume observation with a photograph, an umber soil sample with its site, and a ferrous sensor calibration log, all signed under one identity. Two independent coordinators cross-check the entries against weather records and spot-check one sample within six days. A copied or duplicated entry voids the season, revokes the identity, and bars its sponsor for a season, so a thousand fakes need a thousand real posts, while one honest newcomer staffs just one.
